categories.label: Formal & Dress
categories.rule: Position the formal shoe at a three-quarter hero angle, showcasing the toe cap curvature, leather vamp, and precise welt stitching without altering the leather patina.

categories.label: Bridal & Ethnic
categories.rule: Stage the handcrafted jutti paired or angled gracefully to highlight metallic dabka, zardozi embroidery, and soft cushioned insole detail.

categories.label: Boots & Suede
categories.rule: Capture the boot upright to exhibit shaft height, elastic gusset tension, and velvety suede nap under soft directional rim lighting.

categories.label: Luxury Sneakers
categories.rule: Frame in a dynamic low-angle profile that showcases sole thickness, heel counter geometry, and smooth leather panel construction.

styles.label: Macro Detail
styles.rule: Extreme close-up shot focusing on the welt stitch count, leather grain pores, and burnished heel stack with soft background bokeh.

styles.label: FlatLay
styles.rule: Top-down geometric flatlay on raw unbleached linen with artisan shoemaking horn and limestone elements arranged with intentional negative space.

styles.label: Studio High-Key
styles.rule: Crisp commercial e-commerce lighting on a seamless reflective travertine surface, producing an ultra-clean shadow drop and true leather colour fidelity.

styles.label: Boutique Display
styles.rule: Staged on a bespoke boutique backlit shelf with warm ambient shelving glow and dark wood accents that emphasize premium craftsmanship.

styles.label: Editorial Campaign
styles.rule: On-model high-fashion lookbook capture showing tailored trousers falling perfectly above the shoe collar in natural morning architectural light.

styles.label: Lifestyle On-Street
styles.rule: Street lifestyle shot on sun-warmed European flagstone with soft motion perspective and realistic urban pavement reflections.

backgrounds.label: Pure White
backgrounds.rule: Pure seamless commercial studio white cyc with calibrated contact shadow under the outsole.

backgrounds.label: Warm Beige
backgrounds.rule: Warm sandstone beige background providing high-end editorial warmth for tan and espresso leather tones.

backgrounds.label: Travertine
backgrounds.rule: A solid honed travertine stone slab with subtle mineral veins adding architectural luxury to footwear silhouettes.

backgrounds.label: Atelier
backgrounds.rule: An authentic artisan shoemaker workshop environment with subtle timber workbenches and soft natural window daylight.

lighting.label: Soft Studio
lighting.rule: Balanced 3200K studio softbox illumination preventing harsh glare on burnished leather toe caps.

lighting.label: Chiaroscuro
lighting.rule: Moody side-raking lighting that creates deep sculptured shadow falloff beneath the shoe arch and welt edges.

lighting.label: Gallery Daylight
lighting.rule: Diffused north-facing gallery daylight providing even, naturalistic luminosity across all leather panels.

presets.label: Burnished Leather Preset
presets.rule: Calibrated specifically for hand-patinated calfskin and cordovan leather, enhancing rich gradient burnishing without blowing out highlights.

levels.rule: Matte oil-tanned finish with low surface reflection.
Classic beeswax polish with natural satin sheen.
Mirror gloss toe cap finish with sharp highlight points.
Neutral studio color temperature preserving true dyed pigment.
Warm chestnut amber grading evoking artisanal vegetable tanning.
Deep antique mahogany tones with rich warm shadows.
